rule.name: MockedSubjectInTest
rule.message: This test mocks the class it tests, so it checks the mock instead of the code: a mock of it, or a spy whose own methods are stubbed. Test the real object: pass fakes or mocks of its collaborators in through the constructor, and test a helper through the public method that calls it.

property.name: xpath
property.value: let $injected := //FieldDeclaration[ModifierList/Annotation[pmd-java:typeIs('org.mockito.InjectMocks')]] /ClassType/@SimpleName, $named := for $name in /CompilationUnit/ClassDeclaration/@SimpleName[matches(., '^.+(Tests?|IT|Spec)$')] return replace($name, '^(.+?)(Tests|Test|IT|Spec)$', '$1'), $subjects := if (exists($injected)) then $injected else $named, $mockCalls := //MethodCall[pmd-java:matchesSig('org.mockito.Mockito#mock(_*)')] [not(ArgumentList//*[@Name = 'CALLS_REAL_METHODS'])], $spyCalls := //MethodCall[pmd-java:matchesSig('org.mockito.Mockito#spy(_*)')], $mockAnnotated := //(FieldDeclaration | FormalParameter) [ModifierList/Annotation[pmd-java:typeIs('org.mockito.Mock') or pmd-java:typeIs('org.springframework.test.context.bean.override.mockito.MockitoBean') or pmd-java:typeIs('org.springframework.boot.test.mock.mockito.MockBean')]] [not(ModifierList/Annotation//*[@Name = 'CALLS_REAL_METHODS'])], $spyAnnotated := //(FieldDeclaration | FormalParameter) [ModifierList/Annotation[pmd-java:typeIs('org.mockito.Spy') or pmd-java:typeIs('org.springframework.test.context.bean.override.mockito.MockitoSpyBean') or pmd-java:typeIs('org.springframework.boot.test.mock.mockito.SpyBean')]], $stubs := ( //MethodCall[pmd-java:matchesSig('org.mockito.Mockito#when(_)') or pmd-java:matchesSig('org.mockito.BDDMockito#given(_)')] /ArgumentList/MethodCall/*[1][self::VariableAccess or self::FieldAccess], //MethodCall[pmd-java:matchesSig('org.mockito.stubbing.Stubber#when(_)') or pmd-java:matchesSig('org.mockito.stubbing.LenientStubber#when(_)') or pmd-java:matchesSig('org.mockito.BDDMockito$BDDStubber#given(_)')] /ArgumentList/*[1][self::VariableAccess or self::FieldAccess]), $fieldStubs := $stubs[self::FieldAccess or not(ancestor::Block//LocalVariableDeclaration /VariableDeclarator/VariableId/@Name = @Name)]/@Name, $fields := //FieldDeclaration return $mockCalls /(ArgumentList/ClassLiteral/ClassType | self::*[not(ArgumentList/ClassLiteral)]/parent::VariableDeclarator/../ClassType) [@SimpleName = $subjects] | $mockAnnotated/ClassType[@SimpleName = $subjects] | $spyAnnotated[(VariableDeclarator/VariableId | VariableId)/@Name = $fieldStubs] /ClassType[@SimpleName = $subjects] | $spyCalls/parent::VariableDeclarator[parent::LocalVariableDeclaration] [let $name := VariableId/@Name, $block := ancestor::Block[1] return some $stub in $stubs satisfies ($stub[self::VariableAccess]/@Name = $name and $stub/ancestor::Block[. is $block])] /((../ClassType | *[last()]/ArgumentList/*[1]/(self::ConstructorCall | self::ClassLiteral)/ClassType) [@SimpleName = $subjects][1]) | $spyCalls/parent::VariableDeclarator[parent::FieldDeclaration][VariableId/@Name = $fieldStubs] /((../ClassType | *[last()]/ArgumentList/*[1]/(self::ConstructorCall | self::ClassLiteral)/ClassType) [@SimpleName = $subjects][1]) | $spyCalls[parent::AssignmentExpression/*[1]/@Name = $fieldStubs] /(let $name := ../*[1]/@Name return (ArgumentList/*[1]/(self::ConstructorCall | self::ClassLiteral)/ClassType | $fields[VariableDeclarator/VariableId/@Name = $name]/ClassType) [@SimpleName = $subjects][1])
